description: This file defines the LogNode interface, which specifies a contract for logging components capable of outputting log data and passing it along a chain of log nodes. It includes a method 'println' to log messages with various levels of detail.

classes.name: LogNode
classes.description: An interface that outlines a logging node capable of printing log data and passing it to the next node.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Logs a message with a specified priority, tag, message, and optional throwable, and passes it along the chain.
